newsitem.title: UK: Eurobonds see more euro deals, emerging sovereign.
newsitem.headline: Eurobonds see more euro deals, emerging sovereign.

text.p: Euro Eurobonds and and emerging sovereign provided the focus in the primary market on Thursday.
L-Bank's finance arm issued seven-year deals in marks and French francs, raising a combined 690 million Ecu.
Both the 750 million mark and 2.0 billion French franc legs will be redenominated in euros after EMU, after which they will be merged to form a euro Eurobond.
Houses involved said early response was good, particularly in marks where there was a shortage of seven-year paper. The mark deal was reoffered at a yield spread of 10 basis points.
J.P. Morgan and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell were joint leads.

L-Bank has taken steps in the past year to get itself better known internationally, with the centre-piece being a $500 million five-year deal launched last June. Elsewhere, Croatia launched its expected five-year Eurobond, raising $300 million, slightly more than the $250 million touted at its extensive worldwide roadshow which ended on Wednesday.
The 80 b.p. reoffer spread was more in line with recent market expectations although it was lower than the 100 b.p. mentioned some weeks ago.
Syndicate managers involved in the Croatia deal said investors had eagerly snapped up the former Yugoslav republic's debut international bond offering.

During the investor presentations Croatia's finance minister Bozo Prka highlighted improvements to its economy since the 1995 peace settlement, signed after four years of war. Croatia's foreign currency debt is rated Baa3 by Moody's and BBB- by both S&P and IBCA, the lower end of the investment grade scale.
Dresdner Bank placed a 150 million stg subordianted December 2007 via itself, BZW and HSBC Markets.

Dealers involved said sales of the subordinated debt, at a 40 b.p. reoffer spread, were mainly to British institutions although there was some European placement. Dealers said today's pricing was helped a 250 million stg five-year deal Dresdner launched last year which tightened to trade flat to gilts at one stage from 10 b.p. at launch. Today, it was at a three b.p. spread.
